title: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) frontmatter
description: Structural contract for `_context/planning/adrs/adr-{decision}-v{N}.md`. Produced by stack-evaluation; validated at stack-locking gate.

phase_authored.description: Phase that authored the ADR. Phase 3 (Tech Stack) ADRs cover stack decisions; Phase 6 (Architecture) ADRs cover system architecture decisions including REQUIRED ADRs for Phase 5 flagged_for_architecture_ADR deltas.

tier.description: Candidate tier at time of evaluation: T1=pack pre-pick, T2=pre-loaded catalog, T3=graph-query+web-search.

derived_from.description: Paths to upstream artefacts (shortlist, context.md, product-brief).

options.description: All evaluated options. Must contain at least 2.

resolves_design_delta.description: OPTIONAL — set on Phase 6 REQUIRED ADRs that resolve a Phase 5 flag_for_architecture_ADR delta. Links the ADR to the source design-delta. Phase 6 exit gate verifies every flagged delta has corresponding ADR (silent-divergence guard).

prd_section_affected.description: OPTIONAL — set when resolves_design_delta is set. PRD section the design diverged from.

design_decision_taken.description: OPTIONAL — set when resolves_design_delta is set. The design choice from Phase 5 that the ADR absorbs.

architecture_implication.description: OPTIONAL — set when resolves_design_delta is set. How the design choice manifests as an architectural decision.

prd_amendment_deferred_reason.description: OPTIONAL — set when resolves_design_delta is set. Why PRD wasn't amended (i.e., why the delta was flagged for architecture-ADR rather than accepted into PRD).

id.description: Canonical ADR id, assigned at authoring (VP2 O18). Referenced by prd adr_references (^ADR-\d{4}$).
